questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement I: **Some trains are cars.

**Statement II: **Some cars are trucks.

**Statement III: **Some trucks are ships.

**Conclusion I: **Some trains are ships.

**Conclusion II: **Some ships are not cars.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5687d82dec17fb7e1de65459b6a0067a9a2906fcae32eb1331d7285ab33c2d0e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some trains are ships → **Does not **follow (As some trains are cars, some cars are trucks and some trucks are ships. So it is possible but not definite)

II. Some ships are not cars → Does not follow (As some cars are trucks and some trucks are ships. As no direct relation is given between ships and cars, therefore some ships are not cars is false.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "**Neither conclusion I nor II follows**"

Seven girls P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order). P is to the immediate neighbour of both Q and R. S is not the immediate neighbour of either R or T. V is immediate neighbour of both T and U. V is second to the right of S. Who is sitting on the immediate left of S?
questions.solution:
**Given:** Seven girls P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre.

1) V is second to the right of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94757fca3cb4c6e407d250cebeba5dabfe96d1f90b27af0a48e6af76eb9e8de3.png] 

2) V is immediate neighbour of both T and U.

3) S is not the immediate neighbour of either R or T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f55c970e25d06551ae1c22dd198a9df642786db4bd8d3167652b23bac47911d.png] 

4) P is to the immediate neighbour of both Q and R.

As S is not adjacent to R, therefore R will be positioned to the left of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/319f249a721b6d05a7657a27c78197f7be9970cecd68271fa48126eb5aaca4bf.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, Q is sitting on the immediate left of S.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
